newsitem.title: GERMANY: Telekom shares fall on sell-off news.
newsitem.headline: Telekom shares fall on sell-off news.

text.p: Shares in German telecoms group Deutsche Telekom AG fell sharply on Tuesday afternoon after Bonn sources were reported as saying that the government planned to sell 287 million Telekom shares in 1997.
Shares were down 1.30 marks, or 3.25 percent, at 38.75 marks in afternoon IBIS electronic trade, placing the share among the biggest losers on the IBIS DAX index in afternoon trade.
The IBIS DAX index itself meanwhile was down 14.23 points, or 0.39 percent, at 3,655.08 points.
The government sources were also reported as saying that the German government was considering the sale of its remaining stake in Telekom by the end of 1998.

German Posts and Telecommunications Minister Wolfgang Boetsch said earlier on that Bonn would sell off Telekom shares faster than planned to help cut borrowing and qualify for European Monetary Union.
